# Solution provider partnership

Our Solution provider partnership program is for solution providers who want to market and resell Pipedrive along with their professional services such as sales consulting, onboarding, implementing, and customizing.

[Apply today! Opens in new window](https://webforms.pipedrive.com/f/1rpKI8mqkryhNggwEEk2u0WpCmk0ec3HnkgQU2qT6j4n4gdZh7hrbhsvmVadYaWrN)

![](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/brand-half-page-illustrations/Pipedrive-experience.svg)

**Revenue and licensing perks**

- Discount on list price or commission – earn competitive margins on Pipedrive licenses.
- Royalty-free licenses and demo environment – access Pipedrive licenses and a dedicated demo environment to showcase solutions to clients.

**Business growth and enablement**

- Partner management and enablement training – comprehensive onboarding, training and tools to enhance customer experience.
- Marketing development funds and support – financial and strategic support to help drive demand and grow your business.
- Pipedrive partner directory listing – get featured on Pipedrive’s website alongside top system integrators.

**Dedicated support and expertise**

- Dedicated partner sales manager, channel marketing managers and solution engineers – expert guidance to help you position and sell Pipedrive effectively.

![](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/cdn-cgi/image/quality=70,format=auto/https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/Partners/pipedrive-partnerships_2.jpg)

![](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/brand-half-page-illustrations/Use-Pipedrive.svg)

**Exclusive partner tools**

- Partner portal access, data and insights – gain exclusive access to tools, analytics and insights to track performance and optimize success.
- Service entrance tools to partner-sourced customers – engage and manage customers you bring into the Pipedrive ecosystem and gain access to Pipedrive’s customer base for additional service opportunities.

**Community, events and networking**

- Quarterly updates, partner events and leadership connections – stay informed on product developments and engage with Pipedrive leadership.
- Partner Advisory Council membership eligibility – collaborate with other top partners and influence Pipedrive’s product and go-to-market roadmap.
- Annual Partner Awards eligibility – get recognized for your achievements and contributions as a Pipedrive partner.

**These benefits are designed to empower you as a trusted solution partner, enabling you to drive success for both your business and your clients.**

### Join our solution partner Marketplace

Our Marketplace currently features all our solution provider partners – as well as the more than 500+ Pipedrive integrations in our technology partner ecosystem – but we’re always looking for new businesses to help customers with their digital transformation.

Despite the number of partners we offer in our partner directory, it’s easy for customers to find what they’re looking for thanks to our Marketplace’s partner solutions finder features, like the search bar and categories.

We also like to celebrate our partners in case studies and success stories, like [this one about Wilderness International](https://www.pipedrive.com/en/case-studies/wilderness-international-case-study).

![](https://www-cms.pipedriveassets.com/brand-half-page-illustrations/Marketplace-tools-in-one-platform.svg)

When our clients started asking for CRM support for their mid-sized businesses, we went out and searched the market looking for a partner that could check all the boxes. We needed a solution that was easy to use, was powerful enough for the mid-market and who provided support and financial incentives to make it all work. Pipedrive delivered on all of those needs and more. They have consistently listened to us and our clients by making improvements to the platform and the partnership program every year. Although we get approached by many other solutions, we stay with Pipedrive as no one can deliver product and partner services like they do.
